result.description: A fictional 27-inch ultrawide display designed for color-critical illustration, motion design, and text-heavy productivity. It features a 3440x1440 IPS panel, 144Hz refresh rate, factory calibration, and a built-in USB-C hub for laptops and tablets. The Aster Quill emphasizes workspace clarity, soft ambient lighting, and ergonomic flexibility rather than gaming or storage functionality.
